notes: Starter-size dollar-up and rates-up trades expressing the same tightening tape already seen in PSQ and XLV; both wait for a confirmed breakout rather than chasing today's close, and are small because conviction is seven, not eight or higher.

rule_cited: Macro-First Trade Construction (read dollar, yields, credit tape first) + Decision rule: conviction below eight gets starter size only
teach: Starting small on a trend lets you test your macro view without risking much money if you're wrong.
why: The dollar has climbed sharply this month while interest rates also rise, so I'm starting a small bet the dollar keeps strengthening.

rule_cited: Macro-tape coherence rubric (naming rising rates as the dominant variable) + Decision rule: conviction below eight gets starter size only
teach: You can bet rates will rise using a fund that moves opposite long-term bonds, instead of borrowing to short them.
why: Long-term interest rates have climbed for three months while stocks fall together, so I'm starting a small bet that rates keep rising.
